faq_heading: Homes near Kirkbride Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Kirkbride Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Kirkbride Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Kirkbride Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Kirkbride Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 70 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,272,500, townhomes $617,000, condos $435,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Kirkbride Elementary?
faq.a: Near Kirkbride Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 28 days to sell and closed at 95.8% of the list price, with 1% over asking, across 70 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Kirkbride Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are L.A. Matheson Secondary (0.6 km north), Immaculate Conception School (0.8 km south-west) and Senator Reid Elementary (0.9 km east).

Kirkbride Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 12150 92 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Kirkbride Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Kirkbride Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Kirkbride Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Kirkbride Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 70 homes sold within 1 km of Kirkbride Elementary: 24 houses, 17 townhomes and 25 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $435,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Kirkbride Elementary

28 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Kirkbride Elementary in a straight line (19 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is L.A. Matheson Secondary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Old Yale Road Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Immaculate Conception School (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (0.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Devon Gardens Elementary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Immaculate Conception School (0.8 km south-west), Senator Reid Elementary (0.9 km east), Cedar Hills Elementary (1.2 km north), David Brankin Elementary (1.3 km east), Royal Heights Elementary (1.4 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Immaculate Conception School, 0.8 km south-west of Kirkbride Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Kirkbride Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Kirkbride Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Kirkbride Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Kirkbride Elementary was $435,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Immaculate Conception School, the nearest other elementary school, 0.8 km south-west of Kirkbride Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
